score_meaning: Each pair has a wording score and a meaning score. The wording score shows how alike the two records are in vocabulary structure and word overlap. The meaning score shows how close their ideas are. Both scores are put on a common scale. The rank follows how far the two scores disagree. A high rank means the records read differently from how close their ideas are, or the reverse. The score is a screening signal. It does not show novelty, evidence, demand or value.
